run.description: Add the source a file declares, or replace the one of its name
does: it adds one source and copies no command files, and changes nothing else. It grants no call, makes no hook, and sets no credential's file.
source no-commands: its calls go to https://example.invalid. It names no credential.
call health (read): GET /health. It takes no parameter, and sends no query.
call health sends no body. Its answer is returned as it comes, at most 65536 bytes.
The source names no check call and no idempotency header.
its issues are no bead's link.
its identity keys keep their case.
it sends no hook deliveries into the yard.
it sends no pull-request or CI events.

carried.name: no-commands
carried.text:
name: no-commands
base: https://example.invalid
calls:
  health:
    kind: read
    request: {method: GET, path: /health}
